info.title: AnyLink Protocol
info.description: Harness-independent Personal Agent Network protocol. Cloud Hub provides multi-model gateway, Cloud Memory Brain (hybrid retrieval, async consolidation, automatic device-boundary learning), and real-time WebSocket task routing (/edge/v1/ws). Edge agents manage only their own local environments.
